title: Classify all 386 complete width-four one-matching projector actions
body:
**The width-four binary projector problem has exactly 386 complete action classes, including 40 irreducible classes.** This finite classification answers the width-four part of Nick Petalas's open question in [PR #7749](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7749). **No new kappa** or physical supplier is claimed.

Read the [coverage and conjugacy proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d7da273405eeba7e01bc2332146573a5476092fa/research/width-four-projector-classification/PROOF.md), [complete classification certificate](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d7da273405eeba7e01bc2332146573a5476092fa/research/width-four-projector-classification/classification.json), [factor-pair census](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d7da273405eeba7e01bc2332146573a5476092fa/research/width-four-projector-classification/census.py), [separate matrix path](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d7da273405eeba7e01bc2332146573a5476092fa/research/width-four-projector-classification/matrix_check.py), [replay entry point](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d7da273405eeba7e01bc2332146573a5476092fa/research/width-four-projector-classification/verify.py), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d7da273405eeba7e01bc2332146573a5476092fa/research/width-four-projector-classification/SOURCE-PINS.json) and [credits](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d7da273405eeba7e01bc2332146573a5476092fa/research/width-four-projector-classification/CREDITS.md).

The exact class consists of three-dimensional off-diagonal pattern spaces in ambient F2^4, with matrix-unit graph matching number one, full joint image and the complete pool of rank-one idempotents with nonzero pattern. Equivalence means simultaneous GL(4,2) conjugacy of the unordered complete pools. Reducible actions are included. Canonical transformed factors can have zero off-pattern; the certificate therefore also gives an original qualifying representative for every class.

| Pool members | Reducible action classes | Irreducible action classes |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| 4 | 125 | 22 |
| 5 | 148 | 12 |
| 6 | 59 | 6 |
| 7 | 12 | 0 |
| 10 | 2 | 0 |

A coordinate permutation puts a present unit at E_01. The first path checks all 698,027 two-spaces of the eleven-dimensional quotient and finds 2,070 qualifying anchored spaces. A separate path scans all 65,536 binary matrices, identifies the 120 rank-one idempotents by their rows and products, then enumerates spans of realized patterns. The complete dictionaries agree.

Every anchored space has an explicit conjugacy witness. For each of the 386 class representatives, a separate matrix calculation checks all 20,160 invertible matrices, both inverse products, the full-group minimum and the stabilizer. All minima differ. Testing all 67 subspaces per representative gives the irreducible count. The source verifier runs unchanged; the two known pools occur literally as classes C347 and C384.

Python 3.12, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/width-four-projector-classification
```

Both registered commands print:

```text
PASS_WIDTH_FOUR_PROJECTOR_CLASSIFICATION
698027 planes; 2070 anchored spaces; 386 action classes; 40 irreducible classes
120 projectors; 20160 direct matrix conjugacies per class; 67 invariant subspaces per class
Source classes: {"PR7707": "C384", "PR7749": "C347"}
```

Normal and optimized registered replay, syntax/indentation, committed bytes/source history/modes, export and sealed read-only Git-free serial replay pass. Matching-two and pattern-dimension-two controls are rejected. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44416182243/job/135196964531) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence.

Nick Petalas supplied the second attaining action and classification handoff in the [source proof](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6bd8a384d64b6da2334bc94f6a97cdd74d710780/research/even-one-edge-maximizer/README.md), head `6bd8a384d64b6da2334bc94f6a97cdd74d710780`. Ali Romman's [PR #7707](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7707), head `57e24923b609d2588b83321f530fa2a1e75ed364`, supplies the [even attaining family](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/57e24923b609d2588b83321f530fa2a1e75ed364/research/edge-matching-even-attainment/PROOF.md). His [PR #7692](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7692), head `c2870a38841f515db7203a0761cd77f014f7fb7a`, supplies the [matching bound](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c2870a38841f515db7203a0761cd77f014f7fb7a/research/edge-matching-image-bound/PROOF.md). All nine retained files and their predecessor credit remain intact.

This does not classify larger ambient embeddings. Reducible width-four actions are not global maximizers under the general matching bound. Useful integral exponent relations, paid words, native realization, dirty restoration and the complete recursive invoice remain open. Historical full suites, selected cold replay, Lean and Docker were not run. The selected frontier and all five framework assumptions remain unchanged.
